ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $A$ is a point on the circle $\odot O$, $OD\perp$ chord $BC$ at point $D$. If $\angle BAC=60^\circ$ and $OD=1$, then what is the length of $BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect OC.\\
Since $\angle BAC = 60^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle BOC = 2\angle BAC = 120^\circ$,\\
Since OB = OC,\\
thus $\angle OBC = \angle OCB = 30^\circ$,\\
Since OD$\perp$BC,\\
thus BD = CD,\\
In $\triangle BOD$, with $\angle OBC = 30^\circ$, and OD = 1,\\
thus BD = $\sqrt{3}$OD = $\sqrt{3}$,\\
therefore BC = 2BD = $\boxed{2\sqrt{3}}$.
